claims.statement: Allianz Trade describes trade-credit cover for unpaid or late invoices and asks customers to collect and promptly send relevant supporting information.
Demand hypothesis: embedded deadline and evidence automation will have measurable value because late payments materially affect EU SMEs.

contrary_evidence: Insurers already provide customer claim portals and guidance.
Low-frequency claims may limit direct SME willingness to pay.

economics.acquisition_route: A broker, factor, or accounting platform distributes it across an existing insured book.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 600 SME accounts at 700 PLN monthly can exceed 5 million PLN ARR and support founder net worth above 5 million PLN in four to six years.
economics.founder_time: Three hours daily with specialist review outsourced when needed.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 78-88% margin after exception review and insurer formatting.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 50 SME accounts at 700 PLN monthly cover the build within eighteen months.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 400-1200 PLN per entity monthly plus 2-5% of recovered indemnity.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Receivable monitoring and policy deadlines recur continuously.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Policy-rule mappings and claim outcomes build a proprietary exception and recovery dataset.
fingerprint.customer: EU SMEs with trade-credit insurance, factoring, or insured receivables.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accounting software, factors, and trade-credit brokers embed the workflow for their SME portfolios.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: The agent maps invoice events to policy rules, prompts actions, and exports insurer-ready evidence.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: An insurer, factor, accounting platform, or insured SME pays per entity and successful claim pack.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An invoice crosses a policy deadline while collection actions and supporting documents remain fragmented.

founder_fit: Finance interest and data automation align strongly.
Embedded distribution minimizes high-energy direct selling.
risks: Policy interpretation could be mistaken for regulated advice.
Success fees may be restricted by insurer or broker contracts.

structure.critical_dependency: Accurate policy terms and ERP or bank-feed access.

thesis: An ERP-embedded agent can detect insured overdue invoices, preserve policy evidence, and submit a complete trade-credit claim on time.
title: Trade Credit Claim Packager
uncertainties: Claim rejection causes and volumes are unknown.
ERP partners' integration priorities are unverified.
